description: This file contains utility functions for YOLO object detection, including bounding box processing, image preprocessing, and detection post-processing, using TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, and other libraries.

classes.name: BoundBox
classes.description: Class representing a bounding box with coordinates, objectness score, class probabilities, and methods to get label and score.

methods.name: yolo_head
methods.description: Processes feature maps to produce bounding box parameters, confidence scores, and class probabilities.

methods.name: yolo_correct_boxes
methods.description: Adjusts bounding boxes to match the original image size after resizing.

methods.name: yolo_boxes_and_scores
methods.description: Generates bounding boxes and their scores from feature maps.

methods.name: yolo_eval
methods.description: Performs non-max suppression and filters detections based on thresholds.

methods.name: letterbox_image
methods.description: Resizes and pads an image to fit a target size while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: correct_yolo_boxes
methods.description: Corrects bounding box coordinates to match the original image size.

methods.name: decode_netout
methods.description: Decodes the raw network output into bounding box objects.

methods.name: preprocess_input
methods.description: Preprocesses an image for input into the YOLO model, including resizing and normalization.

methods.name: retrieve_yolo_detections
methods.description: Decodes network outputs, applies non-max suppression, and returns detection results.

methods.name: draw_boxes
methods.description: Draws bounding boxes and labels on an image.
